title: Self-Repair Skill — kallax-self-repair/SKILL.md + 5 步 repair loop
description:
EPIC-164 — 借鉴 loopx `skills/loopx-self-repair/SKILL.md` (5 步 repair loop + dream-up 机制), 给 KALLAX 补 self-repair skill.

**Context**: 主公 2026-08-05 review loopx 后拍板 (P1, ROI 中) — 当前 KALLAX 无 self-repair skill. `check-self-heal.sh` 仅检查 self-heal pattern (禁止用 self-heal 绕过问题), 不是修复工具. `retrospective-routine.sh` (EPIC-161) 可做 consolidate/archive/delete, 但非针对运行时行为异常的自修复. 跟 loopx 对比见 confluence/decisions/loopx-vs-kallax-skill-gap-2026-08-05.md.

**设计 (跟 loopx-self-repair 1:1)**:
1. `skills/kallax-self-repair/SKILL.md` — 5 步 repair loop: pause delivery → build evidence packet → classify failure → assign responsible layer → repair at lowest durable layer
2. dream-up 机制: 重复错误视为 product/process gap, 更新 skill / docs / projection / smoke. **禁止**通过降低 gate / workaround / commit private logs 来"解决" self-repair
3. 配套 smoke test (跟 EPIC-160/161 1:1 pattern)
4. install.sh 自动部署 (跟 EPIC-160 Omnibus 1:1)

**0 增 Rule, 0 改 source code 之外**: 跟 EPIC-161 retrospective-routine 互补不冲突 (EPIC-161 = 阶段性回顾, EPIC-164 = 运行时自修复).
